have h1 : 9 ∈ {m | ∃ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)), G.HasDimension 4 ∧ G.edgeSet.ncard = m} := by
  use 6, K33
  exact ⟨K33_hasDimension4, K33_edges9⟩
have h2 : ∀ m ∈ {m | ∃ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)), G.HasDimension 4 ∧ G.edgeSet.ncard = m}, 9 ≤ m := by
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨n, G, hdim, hedges⟩ := hm
  apply minEdgesDim4 G hdim
exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
